name: LAC
description: gitEnglish-branded Lesson Asset Catalog: linguistic assets and phenomena from a session

RESPONSIVE GRIDS: `.grid-3` MUST use `display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px;`. On print/smaller screens, cards wrap cleanly without horizontal clipping.
